edges.reason: onlyOwner modifier gates transferOwnership so non-owner callers revert.
onlyOwner gates pause; only the owner can halt token transfers.
onlyOwner gates unpause.
onlyOwner gates transferAnyERC20Token, the only function performing an external call.
transferOwnership delegates the ownership state change to internal _transferOwnership after the modifier check.
Ownable constructor assigns owner = msg.sender, establishing the privileged account.
msg.sender supplies the initial owner value at deployment.
Deployer msg.sender becomes the owner state variable.
msg.sender is compared against owner inside the onlyOwner require.
owner state variable is the authorization reference for onlyOwner.
_transferOwnership overwrites owner with the _newOwner argument.
_newOwner parameter reaches the internal _transferOwnership state write.
_newOwner parameter enters the transferOwnership entrypoint.

whenPaused guards unpause.
whenPaused reads the paused flag.
pause sets paused = true.
unpause sets paused = false.
msg.sender is the account debited in BasicToken.transfer.
msg.sender indexes the balances mapping entries that are modified.
transfer mutates balances[msg.sender] and balances[_to].
_to recipient parameter flows into the transfer credit.
_value amount parameter flows into the transfer debit/credit.
transfer performs the balance subtraction through SafeMath.sub.
transfer performs the balance addition through SafeMath.add.
transferFrom subtracts balances and allowance through SafeMath.sub.
transferFrom adds the recipient balance through SafeMath.add.
msg.sender is the spender key in allowed[_from][msg.sender].
allowance mapping is read as the precondition of transferFrom.
allowance mapping is decremented by transferFrom.

_to parameter selects the account credited by transferFrom.
_value parameter is the transferred amount in transferFrom.
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][_spender], so the caller sets its own allowance.

_value parameter is the allowance value written by approve.
_owner query parameter of balanceOf.
balanceOf reads balances[_owner].
totalSupply() returns the totalSupply_ state variable.
allowance() reads allowed[_owner][_spender].

PausableToken.transferFrom delegates to super.transferFrom.

multiTransfer loops calling transfer for each recipient.
multiTransferFrom loops calling transferFrom for each recipient.
_toAddresses array parameter drives the multiTransfer recipients.
_amounts array parameter drives the multiTransfer amounts.
uint8 loop counter i increments to the array length; bounded by require(_toAddresses.length <= 255) so no overflow, but unchecked-style loop arithmetic.
multiTransfer ignores the boolean returned by transfer, allowing silent failures.
multiTransferFrom ignores the boolean returned by transferFrom.
transferAnyERC20Token performs an external call on a contract address chosen by the caller.
tokenAddress parameter selects the callee contract for the rescue call.
owner-supplied tokenAddress controls the external call target, a reentrancy vector if it is malicious.
tokens parameter is the amount forwarded to the external transfer call.
rescued tokens are directed to the owner address rather than to the caller.
if tokenAddress is this contract, the external transfer call re-enters BasicToken.transfer.
constructor credits balances[msg.sender] with INITIAL_SUPPLY.
constructor sets totalSupply_ to INITIAL_SUPPLY.
msg.sender is the account receiving the minted supply in the constructor.
msg.sender keys the initial balance entry created at deployment.
INITIAL_SUPPLY seeds both totalSupply_ and the deployer balance.
